verdict.rationale: A state business-filing portal could plausibly offer a natural-language or AI assistant interface, so this axis applies. The evidence shows only conventional online forms, search, downloadable forms, and a Live Chat support channel; there is no indication the chat is an AI command interface that operates the product. With no evidence of natural-language operation, the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
